July 18, In the Year of Our Lord 1632
    
    Dear Diary, 
        It is Wren again. That rhymes. I just got to London, and might I just say, it is huge. My village has one road and only around 90 people live there. I have never seen so many stores. I walked by a store selling Peppercorns and then I saw another shop down the road selling the SAME THING! Two whole stores! Who needs that many peppercorns? I also saw a shop that had a beautiful dress in the window. It was white and had green embroidery along the straps and waist. I wanted to try it on so badly, but I know that if I were to try it on, I would want to buy it, and sadly I cannot right now. I need to save my money for my trip! I know the cost is great, but I also know that this is where I need to be. I do worry though…

    Diary, 
        I write to you under dire circumstances,
    I went to the creepy house. It was so silent. I didn't know what to do. I wanted to see if I could help, but the house splattered blood on me. I was so scared but wanted to face my fears. Then I saw a gargoyle come to life and eat a squirrel and I ran away. I hope no one goes there ever again.

Hello again Diary, 

        It is Wren still. I have just gotten settled at this lovely Bed and Breakfast. It is called Auntie Mavis’ Bed and Breakfast. It is so cute and the people here are so nice. They ask me where I’m from and why I’m here. It was a little strange at first to have so many grown ups asking about me and why my parents aren’t with me. I had to tell them that my parents love me soo much that they wanted me to go to the New World to experience all of the new things. It was hard to tell them the whole truth though, that I had outgrown my village. I didn’t fit in, the girl who dwells in the woods. It doesn’t matter that I helped all of them survive through the harsh winters, or that I had grown up with them. They are grateful to me, but not welcoming. That is why it was nice to meet some new people. I met this lovely goblin girl named Leaf. She had the cutest dress on, I hope we will become friends. They are going on the boat as well!

Speaking of the boat, I have just learned that it is an underwater vessel. It swims like an underwater beast, submerged below the waves. 
OK diary, I am leaving now, I have just heard about some beasts down by the docks. I am going to go check it out with my new friend Vee. 

    Diary, 
        Wren here again, sorry to keep bothering you, I just came back from my adventure in the sewer. We found a dead werewolf and fought some weird zombie things. I did a good job with my bow, and I think I impressed some people. I am very tired now, Talk tomorrow diary,
        Wren

They stand on the spire of the tower, watching the city's evening glow, looking out over the Thames. They feel a surge of *eureka* come through their brain... an invention! But that's a thing for another time. Now is the time to reflect.

*London. I've spent only days walking on your cobbled roads, flying amongst your haunting smoke, but I can already feel something within me.*

*All those years I've spent manipulating my family, all under the guise of nobility. The years I've spent taxing the poor in my grandfather's name. The years I've spent oppressing and controlling and undermining. Those years end here.*

*It's only been a moon-cycle or two since I met these people. My greatest friend out of them has perished. I'd be lost if it weren't for the future I can see within these stars...*

*These stars... will they be the same stars I look at in the next few weeks? I'm sure they'll be similar. If anything's for sure, it's that Jack – the kind stranger that lit up the warm hearth of compassion within my heart – Jack is up there. And soon will you be, Galileo. And so is Cosimo, but so is every other man and woman and person that has graced this earth with their soles.*

*Compassion takes many forms,* They say, taking out their telescope, *But the kind Jack, and so many others have shown me is special. It was selfless, generous, and wholehearted. I ought to be more like that.*

*And so I will. With this new world, I'll gaze upon the stars and see the new life, the new space, the new galaxies and supernovae and astrophysical secrets they hold.* They look through and find the brightest "star" in the sky: Neptune. *Jack, and all the rest of you, you live in the heavens now. Thank you for alighting upon this world we dwell in. We'll never forget you – I'll never forget you.*

They mark down the "star" as *Jennerius*, and tuck the telescope back into their *Bag of Holding*.
